newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks open mixed, focus 20,500 support.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks open mixed, focus 20,500 support.

text.p: Tokyo stocks opened mixed on Thursday, after dropping sharply the previous day, brokers said. They said the market would watch carefully to see whether the Nikkei average was supported at a technical chart point of 20,500.
At 0007 GMT, the key 225-share Nikkei average was up 37.14 points, or 0.18 percent, at 20,718.81, while its December futures stood flat at 20,690.
"The Nikkei average will seek the bottom today, with the next possible support line standing at 20,500," said an analyst at a major Japanese securities house.
